outcome_evidence: The drawer begins closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then closes the gripper around it (frames 60–125, wrist_image). The upper drawer visibly slides outward, exposing its sides and interior (frames 136–153, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws while the drawer remains open through frame 184 (frames 164–184, wrist_image, image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended scene disturbance is visible.
